item.title: Truck roll-over under railroad bridge shuts road down
item.description: JESSUP, LACKAWANNA COUNTY (WBRE/WYOU) — A tractor-trailer traveling under a bridge has rolled over, causing a road to shut down in Lackawanna County. Constitution Avenue in Jessup was closed after a tractor-trailer rolled over under the railroad bridge around 10:00 a.m. Monday. It is not clear how the crash occurred. item.title: Nick Reiner pleads not guilty in LA slayings of parents Rob and Michele Reiner
item.description: Nick Reiner pleaded not guilty in a downtown Los Angeles courtroom Monday in connection with the killings of his parents, Hollywood director Rob Reiner and his wife, Michele Singer Reiner, late last year.
